priors.posterior-Jeffreys: independent Beta(.5,.5) coordinates, matching the original allocation prior
priors.posterior-mixture: known equal-weight synthetic benchmark population prior: five independent-coordinate Beta components (.5,.5),(2,2),(8,8),(.5,3),(3,.5), plus shared-location/log-scale logistic-normal component. Benchmark-informed sensitivity, not distribution-free evidence.

allocation_objective: E_p|pilot E_fresh-main mean((A_hat-A_true(p))^2); integrate squared error to f(p), not f(posterior mean)

offline_integration.rule: independent scrambled Sobol replicates; prior-weighted pilot likelihood gives posterior; exact finite reward-state risk for each integration point. Same prior points used for both m0 settings. Pool numerators and likelihood masses before division.
offline_integration.convergence: compare policies from first four versus last four scrambles; report disagreement and posterior-risk uncertainty; never increase samples or switch primary method after confirmation outcomes

policy: exchangeability symmetrization of joint risk numerators and pilot masses over all 24 coordinate permutations; uniform randomization among allocations within 1e-12 of the minimum approximate posterior risk; positive integer counts, exact main budget; fixed policy tables before evaluation
deployment_inputs: pilot success counts, m0, total budget, frozen policy table and independent tie RNG only; no true p, main outcomes or confirmation examples
development: all 198 previously seen nonlinear-oracle vectors, including original six stress regimes; development diagnostics only; none used as posterior integration points or for prior tuning

confirmation.components: 16 independent vectors from each of the unchanged six benchmark components

evaluation: exact all pilot/main count probabilities and exact policy tie randomization; oracle diagnostic policies know true p, posterior policies do not
primary_estimand: posterior-Jeffreys relative MSE reduction versus matched uniform/variance-only on confirmation, equal components and m0; vector-cluster paired intervals. These two baselines coincide in this scope.
intervals: stratified paired vector-cluster Welch-Satterthwaite Student-t delta-method intervals, conditional on frozen policy construction; offline integration variation is separately diagnosed across scrambles, not included as reward Monte Carlo error
decision: PASS_CPU_SIGNAL only if primary lower 95% reduction limit >5% and point estimates positive at both m0 settings; otherwise NO_CLEAR_SIGNAL. Secondary prior cannot replace failed primary. No GPU or online-training GO follows from this small scope.
limits: only K4/B16/m0=1,2. Approximate posterior integration does not certify exact Bayes optimality. Population-prior assumptions must be separated from pilot-only information access. New method development after confirmation consumes this holdout.
